meaning:
People descended from Nephil(?), first mentioned at Gen.6.4
giants, the Nephilim

elsewhere.note: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty…
There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
